# spatial-structures.types: OctreeNode

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> One node of an octree. FirstChild is the node index of the first of eight
> consecutive children (ordered by octant: X varies fastest, then Y, then
> Z), or -1 for a leaf. Items is a half-open range into ItemIndices.
